coupons.name: Hole ladder
coupons.dims_mm: 60 x 40 x 6, 2 coupons (vertical axis; horizontal axis with teardrop)
coupons.measure: go/no-go with drill shanks and M2..M5 screws; record printed minus cad; update hole offset 0.10..0.25

coupons.name: Insert coupon
coupons.measure: install Ruthex M3x5.7 at 220 C PETG / 280 C PA6-CF (EST), then pull with M3x12 and a hanging scale to 300 N (EST accept >= 300 N)

coupons.name: Nut trap coupon
coupons.measure: smallest AF where the nut seats by hand without a tool

coupons.name: Clamp slice
coupons.content: split clamp bore cad 24.8, 25.0, 25.2 for the real boom tube offcut, M3 insert + pinch bolt
coupons.measure: free gap with tube seated (feeler), torque 0.25 N m closes it, hold by hand-twist; choose the bore giving gap 0.25 +-0.1

coupons.name: Ring gauge set
coupons.measure: slide on the real joiner; slide plug rings into both ends of the real boom; record fit

coupons.name: Axle ladder
coupons.content: axle holes cad 4.0, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 vertical; ream test with 4.1 mm drill
coupons.measure: DUB248 axle slides without rocking; wheel spin

coupons.name: Slot and tab
coupons.measure: insertion by hand, rock by feeler

coupons.name: Scale and foot square
coupons.dims_mm: 100 x 100 x 36 with 40 mm bore, steps Z 10/20/36
coupons.content: XY, Z and bore measurement; elephant foot at the base edge
coupons.measure: calipers: set XY scale (S1 suggests 1.003), check PA6-CF Z; record foot flare, adjust chamfer 0.4

notes: Estimates are est:true or labelled EST. Negative min_clear/max_clear = interference. Aluminium (6061-T6) tubes, not carbon, are the tubes in the BOM (cad/params.mjs, inventory M-06..M-10).
